items.title: Ella Langley sweeps Country Music Awards as Taylor Swift returns for 1st performance in 13 years
chats: Did you catch the CMAs last night? Ella Langley swept the whole thing.
Choosin Texas is everywhere, so I'm not even surprised.
And Taylor Swift performed there for the first time in 13 years!
Have you listened to Choosin Texas yet? It's the big winner from the CMAs.
Not yet, but my radio plays it every morning, so probably soon.
I bet it sticks in your head by lunch.
Still thinking about that Taylor CMA comeback after 13 years.
I'm watching the clips tonight with a hot chocolate.
Perfect plan for a chilly evening.

items.title: Skipping work to play Grand Theft Auto VI? You're not alone
chats: Apparently tons of people are taking time off to play Grand Theft Auto VI.
Seriously? Like vacation days just for a game?
HR experts say it's far from the first time that's happened, too.
So is GTA VI the reason the office feels quieter today?
Ha, maybe. It came out Thursday, right?
Yep, and people planned their whole week around it.
Any big plans tonight, or is it GTA VI time?
Honestly I'll just watch someone else play it online.
Same, less stress and no controller needed.

items.title: 'Rocky' Fans Break Guinness World Record With 570 Costumed Balboa Lookalikes in Philadelphia - 92.5 XTU
chats: Okay, did you hear 570 people dressed as Rocky in Philadelphia?
That's a lot of grey sweatsuits in one place.
And it set a Guinness World Record for Balboa lookalikes!
Would you dress as Rocky for a world record?
Only if I get to run up the famous steps after.
I'd need a lot of training for that part.
Still picturing 570 Rockys all together.
I'm putting the Rocky theme on for my drive home.
Good choice, instant motivation.

items.title: 151 dancing humanoid robots set a Guinness World Record in Shenzhen - Xinhua
chats: Did you see 151 humanoid robots danced together in Shenzhen?
Wait, in sync? That sounds wild.
They set a Guinness World Record doing it!
Those dancing robots have better rhythm than I expected.
I'd love to see the routine they did.
Imagine them doing a holiday party line dance.
I watched part of that robot dance video on my break.
Was it creepy or cool?
Weirdly cool, honestly.

items.title: ‘Gilmore Girls: A Day In The Life’ Gets New Home On Hulu After Netflix Deal Ends, Release Date Set
chats: Apparently the Gilmore Girls revival is moving to Hulu.
Oh nice, so the whole series is in one place again?
Yep, exactly ten years after it came out on Netflix.
Are you a Gilmore Girls rewatcher?
Every fall, it's my cozy season tradition.
Coffee and Stars Hollow, can't beat it.
I think I'm starting Gilmore Girls again tonight.
Bring a big mug of coffee for it.
Already planning on it.

items.title: Nathan Fielder lookalike contest crowns a deadpan winner
chats: Did you hear about the Nathan Fielder lookalike contest in Toronto?
No way, what did they even have to do?
Business pitches, a staring contest, and improv. Very on brand.
How do you even win a Nathan Fielder lookalike contest?
Apparently by being the most deadpan.
That staring contest must have been intense.
I tried a deadpan face in the mirror on my break.
How did it go?
Lasted about two seconds before I laughed.

items.title: P!nk Adds 2028 Dates to Sphere Residency Due to Huge Demand: ‘This Is Crazy’
chats: P!nk just added 2028 dates to her Sphere residency.
2028? That's planning way ahead.
She said three million people were in line for tickets.
Would you go see P!nk at the Sphere?
Absolutely, her shows are always huge.
Getting tickets sounds like the hard part.
Still can't get over three million people in that P!nk ticket line.
I'm playing Trustfall on the way home.
Great song for a drive.

items.title: A grandmother has 83 Mickey Mouse tattoos, including one on her face, and a room full of his toys: she now holds a Guinness World Record - El Cronista
chats: Apparently a grandma has 83 Mickey Mouse tattoos.
Eighty three? That's commitment.
Plus a whole room full of his toys. Guinness record holder!
That Mickey Mouse grandma is next level fandom.
I have one mug from Disney and thought that was a lot.
She'd laugh at our tiny collections.
I just noticed my keychain is Mickey too.
Only 82 more to go for the record.
Maybe I'll stick with the keychain.

items.title: Airline: Brown substance covering bags was peanut butter, not poop - upi
chats: Did you see the airline story about bags covered in brown stuff?
Uh oh, I'm scared to ask.
Turns out it was peanut butter. Not the other thing.
Imagine opening your suitcase to that peanut butter mess.
I'd be confused and kind of hungry.
Honestly the relief would come first.
I packed a peanut butter sandwich for tomorrow.
Keep it far away from any luggage.
Lesson learned from the airline.

items.title: Glen Powell Joined By Nashville’s Biggest Stars in Raucous Trailer For Country Comedy ‘The Comeback King’: Watch
chats: Glen Powell's new country comedy The Comeback King has a trailer out.
Oh fun, what's it about?
It's full of cameos like Reba, Jelly Roll and Miranda Lambert.
Have you seen The Comeback King trailer yet?
Yes, and Judd Apatow directing sounds promising.
With all those country stars, it'll be a party.
Watching The Comeback King trailer again at home tonight.
Spot all the cameos for me.
Will report back tomorrow.
